text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
“—Up next, the phenomenon that has been
spreading across the world since last year—”

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: Here is news regarding the new infectious disease.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—At present,
signs of domestic spread remain weak—”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—We must continue to closely monitor
the situation overseas—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With Loves Only You finally entering her Senior year,
talks about a certain infectious disease were becoming widespread in the public."

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text: "Haaa, I'm really torn on whether I should head back from overseas once~. Hope this doesn't turn into a bigger mess."

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Well, it's fine for now, and maybe it'll just settle down on its own? These things usually work out that way, right?"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"That said, everyone take care of your health~.
Colds are pretty common around this time of year."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even within Loves Only You's community,
talk about the infectious disease began popping up here and there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was bracing myself, knowing I needed to take proper care of my own health as well—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun,
Happy New Year♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan,
Happy New Year♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ I'm here♪
Well? Were you surprised?
choice_data_list: I thought we were supposed to have New Year's off...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We did that last year too~!
I'm on my off-day right now, that's why I came♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-kun, have you gone for Hatsumode yet?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-chan, have you gone for Hatsumode yet?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪
Well then, let's go together♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, on short notice, I ended up going on a New Year's shrine visit with Loves Only You—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—I'm glad it was less crowded than I expected.
Thanks to that, we've got plenty of free time♪
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we head back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Are you being serious right now?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I absoluteee-ly refuse to go home like this!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: We're on a date today, so let's go have some fun just like this♪ Deal?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

that's so like you.
...Well, that's what's great about you, though.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, geez. Trainer-chan, seriously,
that's so like you.
...Well, that's what's great about you, though.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

Today is officially a date♪
Consider this me "getting spoiled" for the first time♡
choice_data_list: ...Got it! Let's go have some fun, then!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit~♪
So, where are we heading?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What came to mind for now was—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great♪
Let's have a blast with our first karaoke trip!

text_block_list.name: Karaoke Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~
Here's the Special Honey Toast,
Love Heart Deluxe edition~

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

It's just as cute as it was on Umastagram~♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Totally!
It's so adorable, I don't even know where to take the first bite~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll slice it up,
so put some songs in the queue for us, Trainer-kun!
Duets only, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Loves Only You and I spent a wonderful time together right from the start of the new year—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sounds wonderful♪
Let's enjoy our first time at an arcade♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
There sure are a lot of people over there.
choice_data_list: Looks like something straight out of a fighting game.
Looks like something straight out of a fighting game, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loud Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoaaa!
Is this really all the fighting gamers in this town got!?
Man, you guys aren't giving me any challenge at all!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Her attitude and her voice might be loud,
but her skill is the real deal...! 23 consecutive wins now...!
She's strong...!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer B
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe even "Green Tea Tatsu" was taken down...!
At this rate, the peace of this arcade is doomed...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun.
Could you hold onto my jacket for me?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer-chan.
Could you hold onto my jacket for me?”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "I can't overlook this. The selling point of this arcade is its wide appeal, from casual players to hardcore gamers."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: We can't let a few bad-mannered tryhards ruin the balance for everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Loud Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well now?! An Umamusume student is
going to be my opponent?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to our match.
If I win, no more BM-ing, okay?
Let's just have good, clean fun♪

text_block_list.name: Loud Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Fine by meee! If you think you can win, that isss!!
Looking forward to ittt!!

text_block_list.name: Game Audio
text_block_list.text:
『――K.O.
PLAYER 2 WIN!　PERFECT!!』

text_block_list.name: Loud Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a-ah...? Wh... wha-??
I... lost...!?

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer A
text_block_list.text:
No way, her neutral game and wake-up pressure are way too good...
Who in the world is that girl...?!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer B
text_block_list.text:
"To think she'd shut them down so completely...!
Her read was terrifyingly accurate...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the match♪
Make sure to keep your promise, okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Quiet Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm sorry...
I'll make sure to enjoy playing...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Was I being a bit too pushy...? Now that it's over, I'm starting to feel embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I already knew Loves Only You was a fighting game beast
from watching her streams so many times.
Seeing it in person, though, I was completely overwhelmed by her skill...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

In that case, as long as we're here—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
